fixes.target: table-1: Suggested initial intervals for checking portable electrical equipment

rows: Extra low voltage: (less than 50 volts AC): Telephone equipment, low-voltage desk-lights
No if double insulated, otherwise up to 5 years
Photocopiers, fax machines: Not hand-held. Rarely moved
No if double insulated, otherwise up to 5 years
Double insulated (Class II) equipment: Not hand-held. Moved occasionally, eg fans, table lamps
Double insulated (Class II) equipment: Hand-held, eg some floor cleaners, some kitchen equipment
Earthed equipment (Class I): Electric kettles, some floor cleaners, some kitchen equipment and irons
Cables (leads and plugs connected to the above) and mains voltage extension leads and battery-charging equipment
Yes, 6 months – 4 years depending on the type of equipment it is connected to
Yes, 1–5 years depending on the type of equipment it is connected to
